decision: 任务拆分已获批准，可以开始执行 T2 IDL 变更。

tasks.title: Create lifecycle artifacts
tasks.scope: Create SPARK-5 requirement, impact analysis, design, requirement-review gate, design-review gate, and traceable task plan.

tasks.title: Add user status protobuf contract
tasks.scope: Add ProfileService/DisableUser and ProfileService/RestoreUser protobuf messages, then regenerate generated contracts.

tasks.title: Implement user enabled state
tasks.scope: Add enabled state to UserAccount, extend UserRepository, and update InMemoryUserRepository to disable or restore users by user_id.

tasks.title: Block disabled users during login
tasks.scope: Update RegisterOrLoginUseCase and AuthGrpcAdapter so disabled existing users receive PERMISSION_DENIED while restored users can log in again.

tasks.title: Expose user status grpc adapter
tasks.scope: Expose DisableUser and RestoreUser through ProfileGrpcAdapter and map application errors to INVALID_ARGUMENT and NOT_FOUND.

tasks.title: Verify service and gates
tasks.scope: Run Buf checks and user-api Maven tests, record IDL and service evidence, then create Janus gate JSON and rendered reports.
